item.title: Version 3.1.2026.04.06
item.description:
What's New in 3.1.2026.04.06

  • Capture One Variant Detection — Automatically detects variants by analyzing .cos files during scan. Choose to rename (_Variant-01), move to a Variants folder, or leave as-is. Variants are excluded from naming warnings and count mismatches, and itemized in the report.
  • Improved Report Layout — Passed folders now render correctly under their header, with variant details included per folder.
  • Backup Cache Fix — Cached backup results no longer appear in reports when no backup drives are selected.
